html: A stroke happens when blood can't reach part of the brain, either because a vessel is blocked or because it bleeds. Treatment works best when it starts quickly, so call 911 right away and note when the symptoms began.

• Balance: sudden unsteadiness or dizziness
  • Eyes: blurred, doubled or lost vision
  • Face: one side droops when the person smiles
  • Arms: one arm drifts down when both are raised
  • Speech: slurred, jumbled or hard to understand
  • Time: call 911 now
Stay with the person, don't give them food, drink or medicine, and keep track of when symptoms started so you can tell the paramedics.

title: Stroke warning signs
abstract: How to spot a stroke with BE FAST and what to do while help is on the way.
